subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active wake provenance be exposed through a new public `AgentSession.steer` options surface, or kept on internal queue/runtime context types while preserving the existing public steer call shape?
rationale: The PR raises the plugin SDK public export budget and changes a call shape that current main also uses for transcript metadata, so the permanent API boundary is a maintainer product/compatibility choice rather than a purely mechanical merge conflict.

options.title: Keep Provenance Internal
options.body: Carry `inputProvenance` through internal embedded/reply queue options and preserve the current public `AgentSession.steer(text, images, recorder)` compatibility shape unless maintainers explicitly want a new SDK option.

options.title: Accept Public Steer Options
options.body: Allow the new public options object, but require a documented overload that also preserves current image and transcript-recorder behavior with compatibility tests.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but blocked until a maintainer chooses the SDK surface and the author rebases with fresh proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Provenance Internal
recommendation.body: Carry `inputProvenance` through internal embedded/reply queue options and preserve the current public `AgentSession.steer(text, images, recorder)` compatibility shape unless maintainers explicitly want a new SDK option.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged current-main transcript recorder changes are the direct conflict surface that must be preserved while choosing the permanent API shape.
